# PlaceGrid

One fact across the nine places, as a 3×3 grid of results in place order, with a count beneath it.

`Omega.PlaceGrid` · Evidence

## Use

```jsx
<Omega.PlaceGrid />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Omega.PlaceGrid"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Nine results in place order: local, field, parameter, call result, match join, const name, nested machine, another machine, another target. Missing entries are open.
